# Human check (form-commons)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: none yet.

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

The browser side of the human check (D25, ADR 0027): loads Cloudflare's Turnstile script once per page, renders one widget per form id and exposes its token. cms-admin and web use it in their sign-in, 2FA, owner setup and password reset forms; no app imports the script or `window.turnstile` directly. cms-api is the only verifier.

## Techniques

One module-level registry (`Turnstile.client.ts`) read through `useSyncExternalStore`; immutable state per form id (`token`, `status`). The script element is added on the first `useTurnstile` or `TurnstileSlot` mount, never at import; after a load error the failed element is removed and the next mount or `resetTurnstile` adds one new element (no timer). `formId` is typed `HumanCheckForm`. No `window` access happens at module top level (web renders on the server). A widget renders only when both the hook and the slot of a form are mounted.

## Technologies

React 19 (`useSyncExternalStore`), Cloudflare Turnstile explicit render API.

## Entry points

`@abyss/form-commons/human-check` and the root barrel: `configureTurnstile`, `useTurnstile`, `TurnstileSlot`, `resetTurnstile`, and the constants of `src/constants/Security.constants.ts` (`HUMAN_CHECK_FORMS`, `TURNSTILE_TOKEN_FIELD`, `TURNSTILE_SCRIPT_URL`, `TURNSTILE_ORIGIN`, `TURNSTILE_TOKEN_MAX_LENGTH`).

## Where to change what

To protect another form: add its id to `HUMAN_CHECK_FORMS` (and cms-api `public-constants.json`), then use the hook and slot in the form and call `resetTurnstile` after each request. Keep the public API snapshot and the README table in step.
